description: This file contains utility functions and procedures for managing files, directories, building shared libraries, cloning repositories, and generating data models within a software project related to microservices and data model management.

methods.name: rename_file
methods.description: Renames a file from old_path to new_path, ignoring errors.

methods.name: move_file
methods.description: Moves a file from source_path to destination_path.

methods.name: install_json_plugin
methods.description: Reads a JSON plugin file, replaces a vendor prefix placeholder, and writes the result to a destination.

methods.name: remove_file
methods.description: Removes a file at the specified path, ignoring errors.

methods.name: create_folder
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path, including parent directories if necessary.

methods.name: remove_folder
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents if it exists.

methods.name: cd_dir
methods.description: Changes the current working directory to the specified path.

methods.name: obj_has_child
methods.description: Checks if a dictionary object has a child object of type 'object'.

methods.name: obj_has_param
methods.description: Checks if a dictionary object has a parameter with a type other than 'object'.

methods.name: get_option_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified option from a dictionary, or returns a default.

methods.name: get_param_type
methods.description: Returns the parameter type based on a predefined type mapping.

methods.name: get_description_from_json
methods.description: Extracts the description string from a JSON object.

methods.name: get_range_from_json
methods.description: Retrieves the range array from a JSON object.

methods.name: get_list_from_json
methods.description: Retrieves the list value from a JSON object.

methods.name: get_enum_from_json
methods.description: Retrieves enumeration values from a JSON object.

methods.name: is_proto_exist
methods.description: Checks if a protocol exists within a JSON object's protocols list.

methods.name: clear_list
methods.description: Clears all elements from a list.

methods.name: generate_shared_library
methods.description: Compiles source files into a shared library with specified vendor prefix and dependencies.

methods.name: build_and_install_bbfdm
methods.description: Builds and installs the bbfdm component using CMake and Make.

methods.name: build_and_install_dmcli
methods.description: Builds and installs the dm-cli utility.

methods.name: fill_list_dm
methods.description: Populates a list of device parameters by executing a command and parsing its output.

methods.name: remove_duplicate_elements
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from a list based on the 'param' key.

methods.name: fill_list_supported_dm
methods.description: Fills lists of supported data models for different protocols by querying via command.

methods.name: clone_git_repository
methods.description: Clones a git repository to a local path, optionally checking out a specific branch or tag.

methods.name: get_repo_version_info
methods.description: Returns repository info string, including version if specified.

methods.name: download_and_build_plugins
methods.description: Downloads plugin repositories, processes plugin files, and generates shared libraries.

methods.name: generate_supported_dm
methods.description: Coordinates the building, installation, plugin processing, and list population for supported data models.
